import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { users } from "./users";

export const userBlocks = defineTable("user_blocks", {
    columns: {
        id: col.serial().primaryKey(),
        userId: col.bigint().notNull(),
        creatorId: col.bigint().notNull(),
        reason: col.text().notNull(),
        endsAt: col.custom("timestamp without time zone").notNull(),
        needsView: col.boolean().notNull().default(false),
        revokerId: col.bigint(),
        createdAt: col.custom("timestamp without time zone"),
        updatedAt: col.custom("timestamp without time zone"),
        reasonFormat: col.enum(["html", "markdown", "text"], { name: "format_enum" }).notNull().default("markdown"),
        deactivatesAt: col.custom("timestamp without time zone")
    },
    relations: {
        creator: rel.belongsTo(() => users, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        revoker: rel.belongsTo(() => users, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        user: rel.belongsTo(() => users, { onDelete: "no action" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
